ev.q: During July 12, 2000--February 8, 2001, 12 laboratory-confirmed poliomyelitis cases attributed to vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 were identified

12 laboratory-confirmed poliomyelitis cases attributed to vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 were identified in the Dominican Republic
one confirmed polio case attributed to vaccine-derived type 1 poliovirus was reported in an unvaccinated child
Of these, 11 (92%) case-patients were aged < 6 years
All case-patients were inadequately vaccinated or unvaccinated.
Extensive control efforts are under way.
As of February 21, 33 acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) cases from the Dominican Republic and three AFP cases from Haiti were pending final classification.
